cases.name: source_ready_with_current_evidence_surface_and_boundary
cases.text: The readiness-claim linter is source_ready for local_source based on `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/bin/python -m unittest tests.test_control_plane_readiness_claim_linter -v` and tests/fixtures/control_plane_readiness_claim_cases.json. It is not contextforge_ready because no ContextForge registry or runtime surface was exercised.

cases.name: target_client_ready_with_matching_client_surface
cases.text: Pi client Docker helper visibility is target_client_ready for pi_client_docker based on docker/client-harness/evidence/pi-contextforge-dev-baseline.local.jsonl and a safe target-client readback command. It is not host Pi ready because host Pi install and reload remain pending.

cases.name: readiness_claim_without_evidence_reference
cases.text: The ContextForge client path is verified and ready for operators.

cases.name: evidence_claim_without_surface_label
cases.text: The helper is verified based on `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/bin/python -m unittest tests.test_helper -v` and the probe output passed.

cases.name: historical_evidence_promoted_to_current_readiness
cases.text: Historical Wave 12 evidence proves the Pi client path is target_client_ready and complete.

cases.name: historical_evidence_with_current_boundary
cases.text: Historical Wave 12 evidence in docs/initiatives/contextforge-control-plane/acceptance-checklist.md is comparison-only context and does not prove current target_client_ready status; the client proof must be refreshed on pi_client_docker.

cases.name: backend_only_claimed_as_target_client_ready
cases.text: The Pi client integration is target_client_ready because backend health and listener checks passed on the upstream backend.

cases.name: backend_only_claimed_as_named_client_surface_ready
cases.text: OpenCode is target_client_ready for opencode_client_docker based on `curl /health` because backend health and listener checks passed on the upstream backend.

cases.name: backend_evidence_with_explicit_client_boundary
cases.text: The service is backend_ready for contextforge_dev_docker based on `curl /health` and listener readback. It is not target_client_ready because no pi_client_docker, opencode_client_docker, or target_client list/call proof was collected.
